en.headline: Super Typhoon Dolphin expected to bring very hot weather next week
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the storm’s outer subsiding airstream is likely to affect the southeastern China coast in the latter part of next week, though its later track remains uncertain.
body: Super Typhoon Dolphin, currently over the western North Pacific, is expected to bring very hot weather to Hong Kong in the latter part of next week, the Hong Kong Observatory said on Friday.

Senior scientific officer Kong Yu-chau said the system was forecast to move towards the waters south of Japan in the coming days, with a higher chance of heading towards the vicinity of the East China Sea. Under the influence of its outer subsiding airstream, temperatures along the southeastern China coast are expected to become very hot.

Kong added it was still too early to determine whether Dolphin would bring rainstorms to the city because of uncertainty over its future movements. The typhoon has already reached super-typhoon intensity with maximum sustained winds of about 250 km/h.

zh.headline: 超強颱風海豚料下周後期為本港帶來酷熱天氣
zh.dek: 天文台指風暴外圍下沉氣流有較大機會影響華南沿岸，惟其後路徑仍有變數，現階段難料會否帶來暴雨。
body: 天文台星期五表示，現時位於西北太平洋的超強颱風海豚，預計下周後期會為本港帶來酷熱天氣。
高級科學主任江宇舟指出，預料系統未來數日會移向日本以南海域，其後有較大機會移近東中國海一帶。在其外圍下沉氣流影響下，華南沿岸天氣將會變得酷熱。
江宇舟補充，由於海豚未來路徑仍有不確定性，現時難以判斷會否為本港帶來暴雨。該颱風已達超強颱風強度，中心附近最高持續風速約每小時250公里。
